factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table: Profit before tax 6 months 2026 = EUR 27,195 thousand (27.2m) vs 2,695 thousand (2.7m) in 2025. Net profit 6 months 2026 = EUR 7,201 thousand (7.2m) vs loss of EUR 14,411 thousand (14.4m) in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Profit attributable to the parent’s owners was EUR 15.2 million, versus a loss of EUR 2.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for 6 months 2026 = EUR 15,163 thousand (15.2m) vs loss of EUR 2,549 thousand (2.5m) in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Basic earnings per share improved to EUR 0.74 from negative EUR 0.12.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per Share note: Basic EPS for 6 months 2026 = EUR 0.74 vs EUR -0.12 in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The results benefited from stronger energy performance, the addition of agricultural units, closure of unprofitable operations and a major turnaround in supporting businesses, whose EBITDA improved from a EUR 4.4 million loss to a EUR 5.6 million profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The most significant turnaround came from our supporting businesses, where EBITDA improved from a loss of €4.4 million to a profit of €5.6 million.' Also mentions energy performance, new agricultural units (Halinga biomethane plant), and closure of unprofitable operations.

factual_claims.claim: Energy sales volumes fell 34% to 3.3 TWh, mainly due to reduced wholesale activity, while regional natural-gas consumption declined 7%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: 'Elenger Grupp’s gas and electricity sales volumes in the second quarter decreased by 34%, compared to a year earlier, totalling 3.3 TWh (compared to 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025).' Also: 'natural gas consumption in the Finnish-Baltic region totalled 7.0 TWh, decreasing by 7% compared with the previous year (7.6 TWh).'

factual_claims.claim: Nevertheless, the energy segment’s six-month EBITDA increased to EUR 59.9 million from EUR 51.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Reporting table: Energy segment Operating profit before depreciation and revaluation (EBITDA) for 6 months 2026 = EUR 59,891 thousand (59.9m) vs 51,749 thousand (51.7m) in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Maritime transport EBITDA rose to EUR 39.3 million from EUR 33.3 million, although second-quarter EBITDA declined to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 37.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Reporting table: Maritime Transport EBITDA for 6 months 2026 = EUR 39,277 thousand (39.3m) vs 33,292 thousand (33.3m) in 2025. Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Q2 2026 EBITDA = EUR 34,300 thousand (34.3m) vs Q2 2025 = EUR 37,400 thousand (37.4m).

factual_claims.claim: Tallink carried 2.2% fewer passengers, while cargo volumes increased 2.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: 'In the second quarter of 2026, Tallink Grupp and its subsidiaries carried 1,454,725 passengers, representing a 2.2% decrease year-on-year. The number of cargo units transported increased by 2.9% to 68,986...'

factual_claims.claim: Higher fuel prices raised costs by EUR 8.4 million, and the EU emissions requirement increased to 100% of emissions from 70% in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: '- Higher fuel prices increased fuel costs by EUR 8.4 million compared to the same period last year.' and '- The share of emissions to be surrendered under the EU ETS (European Union Emissions Trading System) increased to 100% of the emitted CO2 equivalent in 2026 (70% in 2025).'

factual_claims.claim: Real estate and supporting activities also improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report notes turnaround in supporting businesses. Real Estate segment data (Note 24) shows improved EBITDA and operating income for Q2 and 6 months 2026 vs 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The Group invested approximately EUR 50 million during the first half, including EUR 48.5 million in property, plant and equipment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Purchases of property, plant and equipment for 6 months 2026 = EUR 48,521 thousand (48.5m). Total investing cash outflows = EUR 45,437 thousand (45.4m), consistent with 'approximately EUR 50 million' framing.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow decreased to EUR 99.5 million from EUR 256.6 million, partly reflecting an EUR 88.4 million increase in inventories, while investing cash outflow was EUR 45.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Cash flows from operating activities 6 months 2026 = EUR 99,465 thousand (99.5m) vs 256,619 thousand (256.6m) in 2025. Change in inventories = EUR -88,401 thousand (increase of 88.4m). Cash flows from investing activities = EUR -45,437 thousand (45.4m).

factual_claims.claim: Financing cash outflow declined sharply to EUR 20.6 million from EUR 307.6 million, and cash increased to EUR 253.2 million from EUR 219.8 million at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Cash flows from financing activities 6 months 2026 = EUR -20,612 thousand (20.6m) vs -307,635 thousand (307.6m) in 2025. Cash and cash equivalents at end of period = EUR 253,187 thousand (253.2m) vs 219,771 thousand (219.8m) at beginning (year-end 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets rose to EUR 2.71 billion and equity to EUR 1.20 billion, while the equity ratio decreased to 44.2% from 45.3%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table: Total assets 30.06.26 = EUR 2,714,309 thousand (2.71bn) vs 2,596,607 thousand (2.60bn) at 31.12.25. Total equity = EUR 1,200,533 thousand (1.20bn) vs 1,175,404 thousand (1.18bn). Equity ratio = 44.2% (2026) vs 45.3% (2025).

factual_claims.claim: Net debt declined to EUR 829.9 million, and net debt to EBITDA improved from 3.7 to 3.3.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table: Net debt 30.06.26 = EUR 829,904 thousand (829.9m) vs 851,582 thousand (851.6m) at 31.12.25. Net debt/EBITDA = 3.3 (2026) vs 3.7 (2025).

factual_claims.claim: Infortar also increased its Tallink ownership to 68.76%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: 'In Q2 2026, Infortar acquired additional shares in Tallink Grupp, as a result of which its ownership in Tallink Group increased to 68.76%.'

factual_claims.claim: Geopolitical tensions, energy and fuel-price volatility, interest rates and demand conditions remain important risks.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Future Outlook and Key Risks section lists: 'geopolitical developments, volatility in energy and fuel prices, changes in demand, the general economic environment, interest rates...'

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table: Revenue 6 months 2026 = EUR 945,917 thousand (945.9m) vs 951,869 thousand (951.9m) in 2025
